title: Report to State Government of appointments under sections 10, 11 and 12
text:
13. Report to State Government of appointments under sections 10, 11 and 12.—(1) All

appointments made under section 10, section 11 or section 12 shall be reported to the [State
Government] by the Inspector-General.

(2) Such report shall be either special or general, as the [State Government] directs.
